name: VNDC
oneLiner: VNDC is Jade Labs's VND-denominated token, now disclosed as VNDC 2.0 backed by USDT/USDC pools under issuer and investigation risk.
collateral: Issuer-disclosed VNDC 2.0 USDT/USDC smart-contract collateral on Polygon and BNB Smart Chain; reserve and redemption claims remain high-risk after the March 2026 ONUS/VNDC investigation
pegMechanism: Issuer-controlled mint and redemption through ONUS/VNDC Hub; VNDC 2.0 disclosures describe USDT/USDC collateral pools rather than direct VND bank reserves, with redemption reliability impaired by the March 2026 investigation and withdrawal disruptions

proofOfReserves.provider: Jade Labs / VNDC issuer disclosure (vndc.io origin unreachable, HTTP 521 on repeated checks 2026-08-08; no reserve artefact verifiable)

notices.title: Vietnam criminal investigation and withdrawal freeze
notices.message: Vietnamese authorities arrested ONUS/VNDC-linked executives in March 2026 in a fraud and money-laundering investigation involving VNDC, ONUS, and related tokens. Local reporting also described platform withdrawal disruptions during the investigation, so VNDC redemption and reserve claims should be treated as high risk.

notices.title: Market cap and supply inconsistency
notices.message: Aggregator-reported market cap (~$50M) does not consistently match on-chain Polygon/BSC supply, and reserves are self-disclosed by Jade Labs without an independent audit cadence.

notices.title: Curated reserves are self-reported
notices.message: The curated-validated live-reserves adapter points at the Jade Labs / VNDC issuer website because no third-party attestation page has been verified. Reserve composition reflects the issuer's own disclosure only until an independent auditor or proof-of-reserves feed is published.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: VNDC 2.0 is an issuer-controlled reserve token described as backed by USDT and USDC collateral pools.

listingStatusReview.reason: Temporarily withheld because permitted runtime sources do not provide a positive circulating supply or market cap.
